stage.name: Garden of the Sankta
stage.description:
An ecological park on the lower levels of the Shrine of Nurtury. The myriad creatures here hail from deserts, jungles, seas, and mountains, but they have all become Sankta.
<Dream Tiles> Operators deployed within will be pulled into the dream

witness_of_the_sankta.name: 'Witness of the Sankta'
witness_of_the_sankta.flavourText: Mutated haloed fowlbeast that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have learned to pray and circle above the streets and alleys of the Holy City. They are the Holy City's perception of itself.
abilities: Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
Attempts to steal 1 Ammo from the target when attacking, and deals heavy Physical damage if attempt is unsuccessful

startled_vesperwing.name: Startled Vesperwing
startled_vesperwing.flavourText: A startled Vesperwing will attack intruders who enter its territory at any cost. Their claws and fangs are sharp, and they are both ferocious and impatient. But in their eyes, they're simply protecting their homeland.
abilities: Aerial unit, prioritizes attacking Holy Statue
Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks

flight_of_the_sankta.name: 'Flight of the Sankta'
flight_of_the_sankta.flavourText: Haloed fowlbeast that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have learned to pray, and gotten used to the 'sun' being so close to their heads. They are the aerial extension of faith.
abilities: Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time

starving_gnawbeast.name: Starving Gnawbeast
starving_gnawbeast.flavourText: An Infected Creature that appears in dark places. It has a high reproductive capacity, and is commonly found everywhere. It's currently starving! Be careful, hungry creatures tend to be more violent!
abilities: Inflicts Bleed on allied Operators after several attacks

crawl_of_the_sankta.name: 'Crawl of the Sankta'
crawl_of_the_sankta.flavourText: Haloed terrestrial creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. Empathy has taught these mute creatures the existence of faith. They have learned to pray and they want to know more. They can often be spotted chasing after confessionals in the city.
abilities: Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time

pride_of_the_sankta.name: 'Pride of the Sankta'
pride_of_the_sankta.flavourText: Haloed aquatic creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have learned to pray, and they invite the slothful to pray with them. They will not take 'no' for an answer.
abilities: Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
[Invitation to Prayer] Temporarily reduces all your units' ASPD
